faqs.question: Amek ara sneflieɣ amiḍan deg Podacium?
faqs.answer: Senned ɣef tqeffalt 'Bdu' neɣ 'Jerred' deg usebter agejdan. Tzemreḍ ad tjerrdeḍ s tansa n yimayl, uṭṭun n usawal, neɣ imiḍanen n tmetti (Google, GitHub, neɣ LinkedIn). Fren tamlilt-ik (Anelmad, Akensi, neɣ Tanezzut) sakin ččar amagrad-ik i wakken ad tafeḍ isnasen iwulmen.

faqs.question: Amek ara sentkedeɣ imayl neɣ uṭṭun-iw n usawal?
faqs.answer: Deffir ujered, ad k-d-yaweḍ yimayl neɣ SMS n usentked s tangalt. Sekcem tangalt-a deg usebter n usentked i wakken ad tsentkdeḍ isallen-ik n teɣwalt. Ma yella ur k-d-tewwiḍ ara tengalt, tzemreḍ ad tsutreḍ tayeḍ seg usebter n usentked neɣ seg yiɣewwaren n umiḍan.

faqs.question: Amek ara ssegrewleɣ awal-iw uffir?
faqs.answer: Senned ɣef 'Tettuḍ awal uffir?' deg usebter n unekcum sakin sekcem tansa n yimayl i s tjerrdeḍ. Ad k-d-yaweḍ useɣwen n wallus n usbadu. Dfer aseɣwen i wakken ad tarnuḍ awal uffir amaynut. I tɣellist, aseɣwen yettsala deffir 24 n tesragin.

faqs.question: Zemreɣ ad beddleɣ tamlilt n umiḍan deffir ujered?
faqs.answer: Ih, tzemreḍ ad tesbeddleḍ tamlilt-ik tagejdant deg Yiɣewwaren n Umagrad. Rzu ɣer Yiɣewwaren, syin ɣer Umagrad, sakin fren tamlilt i tebɣiḍ. Tafelwit-ik n usenqed d yisnasen ad ttwabeddlen ilmend n temlilt-ik.

faqs.question: Amek i tettḥadaw Podacium ɣef yisefka-inu udmawanen?
faqs.answer: Podacium tettḥadaw aṭas ɣef wammag n yisefka. Nqader ilugan n GDPR d yisuḍaf n uḥader n yisefka n Lezzayer. Isefka-ik udmawanen ttwafrnen deg usekles d unqal, ur nberreḥ ara yid-sen i wid n berra war ttesriḥ-ik, yerna tzemreḍ ad tsutreḍ asufeɣ neɣ amḥay n yisefka-ik melmi tebɣiḍ seg Yiɣewwaren n Tbaḍnit.

faqs.question: Amek ara jerreḍ deg yiwet n tmsirt neɣ tansuqelt?
faqs.answer: Snirem tiɣuriwin yellan deg teɣult n Uselmed. Senned ɣef tɣuri i wakken ad twaliḍ ifulan, syin senned ɣef 'Jerred' neɣ 'Bdu Aselmed'. Kra n tɣuriwin d baṭel, tiyaḍ s uxellas neɣ s usishel. Akken ara tjerrdeḍ, tzemreḍ ad tawḍeḍ ɣer warraten n uselmed mebla leɛḍil.

faqs.question: Amek teddunt tbridin n uselmed (learning paths)?
faqs.answer: Tibridin n uselmed d izirigen n tɣuriwin yettwasuddsen i wakken ad tessegwreḍ taɣult neɣ axeddim uslig. Jerred deg yiwet n tbridt i wakken ad tafeḍ asaduf amellal n tɣuriwin, teṭṭfeḍ asurif-ik, sakin ad tafeḍ aselken n useddu n tbridt mi tekfiḍ akk tiɣuriwin.

faqs.question: Amek ara rebḥeɣ aselken (certificate)?
faqs.answer: Kfu akk timsirin d yisekyaden yettwasutren deg tɣuri neɣ tbridt n uselmed. Mi tekfiḍ, tzemreḍ ad d-tessufɣeḍ aselken usentked seg usebter n tɣuri. Tzemreḍ ad tbḍuḍ aselken deg umagrad-ik, ad t-id-tessidreḍ d PDF, neɣ ad t-tcerkeḍ deg LinkedIn.

faqs.question: Zemreɣ ad sidreɣ arraten n tɣuri i usqedec mebla internet?
faqs.answer: Ih, aṭas n tɣuriwin mudden-d tiɣbula i tzemreḍ ad tsidreḍ am PDF, ifuyla n tengalt, d yikayaden. Nadi taɣult n 'Tiɣbula' deg yal taɣuri. Ividyuten s yiman-nsen sran tuqqna n internet i usenqed.

faqs.question: Muddent-d Podacium tinaɣdiyin srid (live workshops) neɣ iwebinaren?
faqs.answer: Ih. Podacium tessudus s lebda tinaɣdiyin srid, iwebinaren, d temliliyin n yisteqsiyen d yimussnawen n tnezzut. Ddant deg wammaken usligen yerna ttwalin isental seg usnefli n umahil ar tmusniwt tatiknikit. Isiklanen llan i wakken ad ten-twaliḍ sakkin ma ur tezmireḍ ara ad tḥedreḍ srid.

faqs.question: Amek ara ḍefreɣ asurif-iw n uselmed d tasledt?
faqs.answer: Tafelwit-ik n uselmed tessebgan-d tasledt talqayant gar-asent timsirin yekfan, igmad n yikayaden, akud i tesɛeddaḍ, d usnulfu n tmussniwin. Tzemreḍ ad tesbeddeḍ iswiyen n yimalas, teṭṭfeḍ asurif-ik n lebda, sakin ad tserwaseḍ d yiswiyen n tbridt. Akk isefka ttwasemran deg wakud n tidet gar yibenkaten.

faqs.question: Amek ara sbeddeɣ asenfar d amsafag (client)?
faqs.answer: Rzu ɣer teɣult n Hub sakin senned ɣef 'Sbedd Asenfar' neɣ 'Snulfu-d Asenfar'. Ččar ifulan n usenfar gar-asen azwel, aglam, tasureft, tajumma n tedrimt, d ukud n taggara. Selken sakin berreḥ s usenfar-ik i wakken ad k-d-awḍent tsumiwin seg yikensiyen.

faqs.question: Amek ara azneɣ tasumert d akensi (freelancer)?
faqs.answer: Snirem isenfaren yellan deg teɣult n Hub. Senned ɣef usenfar iwulmen timussniwin-ik, syin senned ɣef 'Azen Tasumert'. Aru tabrat n usurif igerrzen, sbedd tadrimt d wakud i tsutureḍ, sakin rnu ifuyla n umahil-ik yezrin. Amsafag ad iwali tasumert-ik yerna yezmer a k-id-inadi i wmsawal ugar.

faqs.question: Amek i teddunt tura (contracts) d uswiren n umahil (milestones)?
faqs.answer: Akken ara iqbel umsafag tasumert-ik, agatu ad yettwasnulfu. Amsafag yezmer ad isbedd iswiren n umahil s warraten d yixellisen usligen. Azen amahil-ik i yal aswir, amsafag ad t-iselken sakin ad t-iqbel. Idrimen ad ttwaserḥen mebla leɛḍil mi yettwaqbel yal aswir.

faqs.question: Amek ara ṭṭfeɣ idrimen ɣef umahil yekfan?
faqs.answer: Ixellisen ddan s tarrayt taɣellist deg uzaɣar n Podacium. Sbedd tarrayt-ik n uxellas deg Yiɣewwaren ddaw n Ufeter. Mi yeqbel umsafag aswir neɣ asenfar-ik, idrimen ad d-awḍen ɣer temkarḍit-ik n Podacium. Tzemreḍ ad ten-tessufɣeḍ ɣer umiḍan-ik n lbanka neɣ tarrayin nniḍen i yellan.

faqs.question: D acu ara xedmeɣ ma yella umennuɣ d umsafag neɣ d ukensi?
faqs.answer: Ma temmugreḍ-d ugur deg ugatu, sqedec tabaɣurt n uferru n yimennuɣen deg usebter n ugatu. Glem-d ugur s telqayt sakin azen-it. Tarbaɛt-nneɣ n tallalt ad tselken tamsalt sakin ad tmahel d sin yid-sen i ubrid iweznen. Sekles akk tiɣwalin d umahil i wakken ad tessnefliyeḍ tamsalt-ik.

faqs.question: Tizmert n tebbura ad semresnt ikensiyen i yisenfaren n terbaɛt?
faqs.answer: Ih. Tibbura zemrent ad sbeddent isenfaren n terbaɛt yesran aṭas n yikensiyen s tmussniwin yemgaraden. Azaɣar yettɛawan asuddes n terbaɛt s usenfar, aṭṭaf n yiswiren gar yimttakiyen, d ufeter d yiwen. Imsafagen n tmeskanin llan yid-sen yimḍebbren usligen i uselkem meqqren.

faqs.question: Amek ara ssidreɣ tagrumma n yisefka (dataset)?
faqs.answer: Rzu ɣer teɣult n BI, syin ɣer Tegrummiwin n Yisefka. Senned ɣef 'Ssidder Tagrumma' sakin fren afaylu-ik (CSV, Excel, neɣ JSON). Mudd-as isem, aglam, d ticraḍ. Mi yettwasidder, tzemreḍ ad tesleḍ isefka, ad ternuḍ tugniwin tisseknanin, sakin ad tent-tbḍuḍ d terbaɛt-ik.

faqs.question: Amek ara snulfuɣ tafelwit n usenqed (dashboard)?
faqs.answer: Rzu ɣer BI > Tifelwiyin n Usenqed sakin senned ɣef 'Snulfu Tafelwit'. Rnu ifurkawen (widgets) s ufran n tewsit n tuggna sakin zdi-ten d tegrummiwin-ik n yisefka. Beddel asuddes, rnu imsizdigen, sakin sbedd asekfel awurman. Sekles sakin bḍu tafelwit-ik d yimastaren n tuddsa.

faqs.question: Amek teddunt tuddsiwin deg Podacium BI?
faqs.answer: Tuddsiwin ssurfent i trebbaɛ ad ddukklent ɣef tegrummiwin n yisefka, tifelwiyin, d uneqqis. Snulfu tuddsa sakin ɛreḍ imastaren s yimayl. Sbedd timlilin d yizerfan n yal amastan. Akk imastaren n tuddsa zemren ad awḍen ɣer tɣubla yettwabḍan ilmend n tezmert-nsen.

faqs.question: Zemreɣ ad bḍuɣ tifelwiyin n usenqed d wid n berra?
faqs.answer: Ih. Tifelwiyin zemrent ad ttwabḍunt s yiseɣwan uzayazen s wawal uffir ma tebɣiḍ, ad ttwaseddment deg yismal web neɣ timsiknin, neɣ ad d-ttwasufɣent d uneqqis n PDF. Kečč i yeṭṭfen izerfan n unekcum yerna tzemreḍ ad tesbeddeḍ azemz n taggara i yiseɣwan i wakken ad tḥadreḍ ɣef tɣellist n yisefka.

faqs.question: Anta ahilen n usishel (plans) i yellan?
faqs.answer: Podacium temmud-d aṭas n wahilen: Baṭel (anekcum amezwaru), Anelmad Tazwara, Anelmad Plus, d Unelmad Pro i yinelmaden; BI Timmerwit d BI Aselkem i tebbura. Yal ahil yesɛa timura d yiswiyen yemgaraden. Rzu ɣer usebter n Wazaɣen i usegzi ummid.

faqs.question: Amek ara sserfeɣ neɣ ad sfexteɣ asishel-iw?
faqs.answer: Rzu ɣer Yiɣewwaren > Afeter i wakken ad twaliḍ ahil-ik amiran. Senned ɣef 'Sserfeɣ' i wakken ad tferneḍ aswir ɛlayen, neɣ 'Sfext Asishel' i wakken ad tuɣaleḍ ɣer wahil n baṭel. Asnerni ad yebdu imir-imir s uḥsab azizdeg. Asfexet ad yekcem deg umennuɣ deg taggara n tallit-ik tamirant n ufeter.

faqs.question: Anta tarrayin n uxellas i yettwaqeblen?
faqs.answer: Podacium teqbel tikarḍiwin n usnefti d uselkem meqqren, aselkem n lbanka, d tarrayin n temnaḍt ilmend n wanda telliḍ. Akk ixellisen ddan s tɣellist tameqqrant s tallalt n yimriken-nneɣ n uxellas. Tarrayin n uxellas zemrent ad ttwaglemnt deg Yiɣewwaren > Afeter.

faqs.question: D acu-t usaḍuf n uṛeṭṭal n tedrimt (refund)?
faqs.answer: Nettmuddu-d aṛeṭṭal n tedrimt deg 14 n wussan seg wasmi d-tuɣeḍ asishel ma yella ur tesqedceḍ ara aṭas timura tusligin. I tɣuriwin s timmad-nsent, aṛeṭṭal yella deg 7 n wussan ma tesɛeddaḍ ddaw n 25% seg tɣuri. Muqel usebter n Usaḍuf n Uṛeṭṭal i yifukan ummiden.

faqs.question: Tettmuddum-d afeter i tebbura meqqren neɣ trebbaɛ?
faqs.answer: Ih. Ahilen n tebbura meqqren sɛan afeter d yiwen i trebbaɛ, timlilin tusligin n yiseqdacen, amḍebber uslig n umiḍan, tallalt tamezwarut, d useddu amaynut. Ssiweḍ ɣer terbaɛt-nneɣ n uznuzu i uswir uslig. Ahilen n useggas n tebbura sɛan daɣen aḥader ameqqran ɣef tedrimt s usegzi d yisishel imenza.
